activities.body: RFP 202519 awarded June 2025; services agreement effective 2025-07-01 with two one-year renewals. Blanket PO issued each October.

activities.subject: Quarterly contract review
activities.body: Reviewed Q3 call-outs (storm drain, wash bay). Marcus asked for a text when crews are en route. Dana confirmed the FY27 blanket PO is in process.

activities.body: Refuse truck 118 blew a hydraulic line in the wash bay. Oil in the bay and into the oil-water separator; bay is closed. Wants the crew tomorrow morning. PO release to follow from Dana.

activities.body: Logan, Tristan and Joe on site 8:00. Vactron and the spill trailer. Please leave the wash bay closed overnight.

activities.body: Tractor backed into a bollard; saddle tank split. Estimated 100–120 gallons on the pavement, running toward the swale. Insurance claim with Progressive. Work authorization signed on arrival.

activities.author: Logan Gallman

activities.subject: Invoice 2026-0501-01 and after photos
activities.body: Two nights complete. Invoice paid 2026-05-28.

activities.subject: Propose a quarterly garage wash schedule

activities.author: Logan Gallman
activities.subject: Treatment 1 complete
activities.body: Applied 10 gallons Mega-Bac X from the spray trailer overnight 9/20. DO 3.1 mg/L at the outfall. Next treatment ~10/20.

activities.subject: Luis Ortega — forklift battery acid on Dock 4
activities.body: Forklift battery cracked during a swap; roughly 5 gallons of acid on the dock, some into the floor drain. Dock closed. New customer — packet sent, waiting on the work authorization before we roll.

activities.author: Charlotte Stautzenberger

activities.body: Packet, W-9 and work authorization sent for signature. Crew can be there within the hour of the signed authorization.

activities.body: Wade wants the lagoon down by 10/12. Balfour excavator penciled for 10/12–10/16; liner material ships 10/9. Republic profile submitted.

activities.subject: Mike Balfour — October excavator availability

dailyNarratives.sceneDescription: Roughly 120 gallons of diesel from a split saddle tank on a tractor at the fuel island. Product across about 2,400 sq ft of pavement and into the concrete drainage swale toward the culvert; customer had spread floor dry.
dailyNarratives.sceneActivities: Boomed the culvert, vacuumed free product and floor dry, hot-water pressure-washed the pavement with recovery, drummed the recovered liquid (4 x 55 gal), applied Micro-Bac-S to the wash zone.

dailyNarratives.sceneDescription: Residual staining on the swale walls; sheen in standing water at the culvert inlet. Tractor moved to the shop.
dailyNarratives.sceneActivities: Sandbagged the culvert, recovered the standing water, treated the swale walls with Micro-Bac-S, collected two confirmation soil samples, LiDAR scan of the yard and swale for the claim file.

postJobReview.notes: No incidents. Heat index over 100 — two extra hydration breaks.

dispatchJobs.jobName: Stage 1 — containment and free product recovery
dispatchJobs.description: Mobilize to the caliche pad, set containment below the valve, recover free product and rainwater, stage roll-offs.

dailyNarratives.sceneDescription: Crude release at the valve set, pooled in a low spot about 60 ft downslope; staining across roughly 3,000 sq ft of the pad and the bar ditch toward the stock tank.
dailyNarratives.sceneActivities: Boomed the bar ditch, built the containment berm, vacuumed free product and rainwater to the frac tank, staged Venditti roll-offs, set the treatment windrow area.

dispatchJobs.projectName: Permian Midstream — Taylor valve site crude release
dispatchJobs.description: Excavate impacted soil to clean sidewalls, build and spray treatment windrows with Mega-Bac X, PID screen sidewalls, stage for confirmation sampling.

dailyNarratives.sceneDescription: Containment holding; free product gone from the low spot. Impacted soil across the release footprint to about 3 ft.
dailyNarratives.sceneActivities: Excavated the east half to 3 ft, built windrows 1 and 2 on poly, sprayed Mega-Bac X, PID screening of the sidewalls. Excavator hydraulic line found weeping at end of day.

dailyNarratives.sceneDescription: East half excavated; windrows 1–3 built. Balfour excavator on site.
dailyNarratives.sceneActivities: Windrows turned and re-sprayed; west half excavation started; sidewall PID 12–40 ppm on the east.

dailyNarratives.sceneDescription: Former UST pad north of the kitchen; grease line trench to the east tree line. Stained soil at the cleanout.
dailyNarratives.sceneActivities: Borings B-1 through B-3 at the UST pad; PID screening every 2 ft; samples at 4 ft and 10 ft.

dailyNarratives.sceneDescription: East tree line along the grease line trench; soft ground after rain.
dailyNarratives.sceneActivities: Borings B-4 through B-6 along the grease line; samples at 2 ft and 6 ft; cuttings drummed; COC completed and samples on ice to Eurofins.

accountRelationshipExtensions.businessDescription: Hazardous materials management and spill response under RFP 202519. Standing contract; emergency call-outs come through Public Works and the Fire Department.
accountRelationshipExtensions.workingRelationshipNotes: Contract awarded June 2025. Rate sheet pricing per the RFP response; emergency minimums apply.

accountRelationshipExtensions.businessDescription: Regional trucking company; saddle-tank rupture at their Round Rock yard, July 2025. Paid through a Progressive Commercial claim.
Insurance carrier on the Lone Star Freight diesel release. Adjuster approved the scope; invoice copied to the claim.
Property manager for retail centers between Round Rock and Temple. Fire debris and hydraulic fluid cleanup at a vacant strip center, August 2025.
Gathering-line operator. Crude release at a valve site near Taylor; multi-stage excavation, treatment and backfill under way.
Hotel owner-operator. Subsurface investigation at a hotel after a grease-line failure and historical fuel tank; borings complete, lab results pending.
Garage operator. Night pressure-wash and degrease of a three-level garage after a transformer oil leak.
Medical office condominium association. Sewage backup into the building crawlspace; pump-out, cleanout and bacteria treatment, March 2026.
Homeowners association. Night application of Mega-Bac X to the amenity pond after a fish kill; scheduled follow-up treatments.
Grocery distribution center. Forklift battery acid spill on the loading dock, called in 2026-09-25.
Dairy co-op. Wastewater lagoon liner tear; sludge removal and liner repair planned for October.
Precast plant. Asked about cleaning out the wash-water settling pit.
Fire district. Drone demo and spill-response training day held at Station 2; interested in a standing response agreement.
County fleet yard. Fuel island staining; wants a soil investigation before the island is rebuilt.
School district. Bus barn oil-water separator and wash bay sump cleaning.
Chemical distributor. Negotiating a standing emergency response agreement with a 4-hour minimum call-out.
Poultry processor. Lost the litter pond remediation bid to Lone Star HazMat on price.
Asbestos abatement and demolition subcontractor. Used on abatement scopes and for excavation support.
Non-hazardous waste hauling and disposal; third-party waste authorization form goes to them.
Analytical laboratory for soil and water samples (TPH, BTEX, metals).
Roll-off boxes and dump trucks for debris and soil haul-off.
